product: GPT-5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026
tagline: OpenAI GPT 5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026.
what_it_does: OpenAI GPT 5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026. OpenAI GPT 6 Luna is the recommended replacement. API calls to GPT 5 nano are not redirected after that date, so migrate your workloads before December 11, 2026.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: OpenAI GPT 5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026. OpenAI GPT 6 Luna is the recommended replacement.
key_takeaway: OpenAI GPT 5 nano will be retired on December 11, 2026.
